summary: Master effective communication for customer service success. Enroll in our training course to elevate your team's skills and enhance customer satisfaction!
lede: Effective customer service communication helps frontline practitioners and team leaders handle enquiries, complaints and escalations clearly. The training develops active listening and questioning, structured responses using DESC, and SBAR handovers, with practice adapting messages and CRM records for voice, email and chat. It also covers complaint handling and service-quality measures such as CSAT, CES and NPS, helping teams review interaction quality and identify areas for improvement.
audienceIntro: This customer service communication course is designed for frontline practitioners, operational specialists, and service leaders who need to improve conversation quality, complaint handling, escalation discipline, and omnichannel consistency. It suits professionals who already handle or oversee customer interactions and want an intermediate, structured approach.
modules: Active Listening for Customer Service Communication
prerequisites: You should bring examples of recurring customer enquiries, escalation patterns, or quality challenges where organizational confidentiality permits. The course uses provided case records and templates, so access to live customer data is unnecessary. A laptop with spreadsheet software and a web browser supports the dashboard and digital template exercises.
